what: The feedforward mushroom body of docs/RESULTS.md sections 1 and 2, from the MaleCNS v1.0 connectome (minconf 0.5, no synapse threshold). A model of the wiring, not a recording of a fly.

source.connectome: MaleCNS v1.0 (HHMI Janelia Research Campus and Google Research), CC BY 4.0

coords.units: MaleCNS voxels (integers, as in the annotation table's somaLocation)

axes.x: fly right to fly left (x increases toward the fly's left)
axes.z: anterior to posterior (z increases posteriorly; the ventral nerve cord lies at large z)

coords.front_view: plot x to the right and y downward: the brain seen from the front, the fly's left on the viewer's right
coords.normalisation: none; positions are raw voxel coordinates

position_flag.1: tosomaLocation (scanned point on the neurite toward a missing soma)
position_flag.2: stand-in: mean soma of the same type and side
position_flag.3: stand-in: mean soma of the same type
position_flag.4: stand-in: mean soma of the population

sparsity.status: set by hand: top 5% of the drivable Kenyon cells fire (k-winners-take-all), a stand-in for APL inhibition

kwta_k.rule: k = max(1, round(sparsity * n_drivable)); winners with zero drive are dropped

binary_code.status: set by hand: a Kenyon cell fires (1) or not (0); the main condition of every result

constants.odour_status: synthetic: six random glomeruli (or six visual projection types), the antennal lobe bypassed

lr.status: CALIBRATION, not a result: set once so one pairing drops odour A's drive onto MBON11 by 0.90 (Hige et al. 2015). With a binary code the calibration returns 0.9 (to floating-point rounding) for any odour; each fixture records the exact value it used

recover_rate.status: 1 = the published rule (Gkanias et al. 2022). Lower values are a rule change; they fix same-compartment coexistence but are not the published rule

constants.rule: dW = -lr * delta[mbon] * strength * (code[kc] + recover_rate * (W - w_rest)); W = clamp(W + dW, w_min, w_max)
constants.delta_rule: per MBON: sum of synapses from the chosen DAN types, averaged over the cells of that MBON type, divided by the maximum

valence.status: rule of thumb (Aso et al. 2014): GABA or acetylcholine MBON = approach (+1), glutamate = avoid (-1)

beta.status: FITTED motor gain: one number, fitted so the T-maze index lands in the wild-type range (0.44 to 0.53 is met near 10 to 11)

constants.choice: score(X) = sum(valence * drive(X)) / N, N = mean over the odour set of sum(|drive|) on the untrained circuit; P(X over Y) = 1 / (1 + exp(-beta * (score(X) - score(Y))))

model_seed.status: seeds the fixed random order that breaks ties in the k-winners-take-all (kc.tiebreak_rank)

apl.note: shown for anatomy; the model replaces its feedback with the k-winners-take-all (RESULTS 4.5 tests the real loop)

pn_kc.layout: CSR, rows = Kenyon cells, columns = projection neurons; values = synapse counts

vpn_kc.layout: CSR, rows = Kenyon cells, columns = visual projection neurons; values = synapse counts

kc_mbon.layout: CSR, rows = MBONs, columns = Kenyon cells; values = synapse counts. Edge e (0..nnz-1) in this order is the model's plastic synapse e: one weight W[e] per entry

dan_mbon.layout: COO, rows = MBONs, columns = DANs; values = synapse counts
